about: Shell texts the design copy deck lacks. Each is written into the four Shell catalogs (packages/shell/src/i18n/catalogs/<lang>.json) exactly as here; fa and ckb await a native speaker's review. copy-deck.mjs keys/apply/check --extras reads this file; references/translation-workflow.md shows the same table. The copy deck itself is never edited here.
